method: Each case constructs the real feature with its default constructor, seeds a real caller Random, and calls the native place(). Every write, every dependency answer and both Random streams are native observations. The caller's stream stays untouched because the feature seeds its own local Random.
encoding: block_names interns the names; each scene is base64(zlib(repeated <hhhH> x,y,z,name_index)); a case stores only the cells that changed from its scene.
